summary: 75-year-old woman overdue after departing Monarch Lake trailhead for the lake loop; took a wrong turn up Arapaho Pass Trail and bivouacked overnight; walked into staging uninjured the next morning after an all-night search.
location: Monarch Lake trailhead / Arapaho Pass Trail
notes: Notified 10:00 pm Aug 7; first teams in field by 11:30 pm; all teams out by 5:00 am Aug 8 with no clues; subject walked into staging just before 8:30 am Aug 8. GCSAR drone and Front Range Rescue Dogs involved.
